name: v0.64.1
body:
This patch release fixes datagram receive cancellation and stream reset handling.

## Notable Fixes

* `Conn.ReceiveDatagram` now fails immediately if the context is already canceled: [#5947](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5947)
* http3: `Stream.ReceiveDatagram` and `RequestStream.ReceiveDatagram` now fail immediately if the context is already canceled: [#5948](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5948)
* Stream reset handling now ignores reliable boundary updates after cancellation: [#5950](https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5950)

## Changelog
* ignore reliable boundary updates after stream cancellation by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5950
* fail Conn.ReceiveDatagram if the context is already canceled by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5947
* http3: fail Stream.ReceiveDatagram if the context is already canceled by @marten-seemann in https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/pull/5948


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/quic-go/quic-go/compare/v0.64.0...v0.64.1
